lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: There is a charter. Nine pages, five signatures, and a clause voting never to publish. It is in the end room and it is not locked, because nobody has ever needed to lock it.

lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: So. Thursday is in two days and I have spent four years being outvoted politely. What are we doing.

choices.text: Put the charter in front of the press before the vote.
Burn the room. The weights are on tape and the tape is in there.
Come with us instead. There is more of this than one Thursday.
